name: nextjs-app-router-patterns
description: Next.js 14+ App Router patterns: Server Components, streaming, parallel/intercepting routes, SSR/SSG, caching, data fetching, Server Actions, and full-stack React. Use for new apps, Pages Router migration, optimization, and modern React development.

Modes: Server Components=server/data/secrets/heavy computation; Client Components=browser/interactivity/hooks/browser APIs; Static=build time/rarely changing; Dynamic=request time/personalized or real-time; Streaming=progressive/large or slow pages.

App files: layout.tsx (shared wrapper), page.tsx (route UI), loading.tsx (Suspense loading), error.tsx (error boundary), not-found.tsx (404), route.ts (API endpoint), template.tsx (remounted layout), default.tsx (parallel fallback), opengraph-image.tsx (OG image).

Patterns:
- `app/layout.tsx`: `Inter` from `next/font/google`, `Providers`, metadata, `<html lang="en" suppressHydrationWarning>`, and `<body className={inter.className}>`.
- `app/page.tsx`: Server Component by default; async `fetch('https://api.example.com/products', { next: { revalidate: 3600 } })`.
- `app/products/page.tsx`: await `searchParams: Promise<SearchParams>`; use `Suspense`, `ProductList`, `ProductListSkeleton`, `FilterSidebar`; support `sort?: 'price' | 'name' | 'date'`, `category`, and `page`.
- `components/products/ProductList.tsx`: colocate async fetching; `fetch(..., { next: { tags: ['products'] } })`; throw `new Error('Failed to fetch products')` when `!res.ok`; render grid, `ProductCard`, and `Pagination`.
- `components/products/AddToCartButton.tsx`: client interactivity with `useState`, `useTransition`, and `addToCart` from `@/app/actions/cart`.
- `app/actions/cart.ts`: import `revalidateTag` from `"next/cache"`, `cookies` from `"next/headers"`, and `redirect` from `"next/navigation"`; use session cookie and `db.cart.upsert`; return `{ success: true }` or `{ error: "Failed to add item to cart" }`. `checkout(formData: FormData)` validates `address` and `payment`, calls `processOrder`, then `redirect(\`/orders/${order.id}/confirmation\`)`.
- `app/dashboard/layout.tsx`: parallel slots `analytics` and `team`; render dashboard grid with main and two asides. Slot pages fetch `getAnalytics`/`getTeamMembers`; each has `loading.tsx`.
- Photo modal: `app/<REDACTED_USER>/(.)photos/[id]/page.tsx` intercepts; `app/photos/[id]/page.tsx` is the full page. Await `params: Promise<{ id: string }>` and `getPhoto(id)`; modal uses `Modal` and `PhotoDetail`; full page also renders `RelatedPhotos`.
- `app/layout.tsx` may accept `modal: React.ReactNode`.
- `app/product/[id]/page.tsx`: await `params`; fetch blocking product first, then stream `Reviews` and `Recommendations` in separate `<Suspense>` boundaries with skeleton fallbacks. These async components fetch their own data.
- `app/api/products/route.ts`: use `NextRequest`, `NextResponse`; `GET` reads `request.nextUrl.searchParams`, queries `db.product.findMany`, and returns `NextResponse.json(products)`; `POST` reads `await request.json()`, creates via `db.product.create`, and returns `NextResponse.json(product, { status: 201 })`.
- `app/api/products/[id]/route.ts`: await `{ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }`; query `db.product.findUnique`; return `NextResponse.json({ error: "Product not found" }, { status: 404 })` or the product.
- `app/products/[slug]/page.tsx`: `generateMetadata`, `notFound`, and `generateStaticParams` (query `db.product.findMany({ select: { slug: true } })`); await `params`, return product metadata/images, and call `notFound()` when absent.

Caching:
`fetch(url, { cache: "no-store" });`
`fetch(url, { cache: "force-cache" });`
`fetch(url, { next: { revalidate: 60 } });`
`fetch(url, { next: { tags: ["products"] } });`
Invalidate with `revalidateTag`/`revalidatePath` from `"next/cache"` after `db.product.update({ where: { id }, data })`.

**Start with Server Components** - Add 'use client' only when needed
**Colocate data fetching** - Fetch data where it's used
**Use Suspense boundaries** - Enable streaming for slow data
**Leverage parallel routes** - Independent loading states
**Use Server Actions** - For mutations with progressive enhancement
**Don't pass serializable data** - Server → Client boundary limitations
**Don't use hooks in Server Components** - No useState, useEffect
**Don't fetch in Client Components** - Use Server Components or React Query
**Don't over-nest layouts** - Each layout adds to the component tree
**Don't ignore loading states** - Always provide loading.tsx or Suspense
